metrics.label: Median asking rent
metrics.description: Middle asking rent among available listings; not achieved or effective rent.

metrics.label: Median asking sale price
metrics.description: Middle asking price among available sale listings; not a property valuation.

metrics.label: Median recorded sale price
metrics.description: Middle publisher-filtered recorded sale price; housing composition can change.

metrics.label: Sale price index
metrics.description: Publisher repeat-sales index; not a price, price per square foot or independently verified index base.

metrics.label: Rental index
metrics.description: Publisher repeat-listing rental index; not a rent or independently verified index base.

metrics.label: Days on market
metrics.description: Median listing-to-contract days; negative source values are retained and flagged.

metrics.label: Rental listings with rent cuts
metrics.description: Share of active rental listings with rent cuts; not the size of a concession. Native fractions retained.

metrics.label: Sales listings with price cuts
metrics.description: Share of active sale listings with price cuts. Native fractions retained.

metrics.label: Recorded sales volume
metrics.description: Publisher recorded-sales count; not necessarily equal to an unfiltered Rolling Sales count.

metrics.label: Rental listing inventory
metrics.description: Listings available during the period, not vacancy, occupied rentals or affordable housing availability.

metrics.label: Sale / initial list-price ratio
metrics.description: Median ratio among matched listings and sales; values above one are not automatically anomalous.

metrics.label: Sales listing inventory
metrics.description: Sale listings available during the period, not a point-in-time count or complete property inventory.

provenance.geography_policy: Publisher labels only; no boundaries, CD crosswalk or property assignment.
provenance.value_policy: Exact native values, nulls and source months; no interpolation or aggregation.
